Match clean cute anime illustration linework and shading. Asset type: a four-frame 2 by 2 sprite pose study on TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha. Exactly one instance of the character in each equal quadrant, reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right; equal scale, ample transparent gutters, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no decorative stars, no extra props. Each cell must have the SAME pose placement and camera. All hair and clothes remain within each cell. The tiny motion changes should be useful as an animation loop rather than four unrelated drawings. Action: comfortably curled up sleeping on her side, full curled body drawn horizontally, legs tucked toward tummy under her modest skirt, arms tucked under tilted cheek, closed smiling crescent eyes, tiny sweet sleeping smile and rosy cheeks, fluffy hair pooled around her like a nest. Face oriented toward viewer and located in upper-front half of curled silhouette. Four phases: restful end-exhale, very slight inhale raising shoulders 2%, peak inhale soft cheek shift, relaxed exhale. Not upright sitting, not a floating detached head. No pillow or blanket needed; her hair cushions her. Later the desktop screen bottom will occlude most of this pose, leaving half the sleeping face visible, but DRAW THE COMPLETE curled character here with no border or occlusion.
